paper.name: Papercraft pop-up
paper.lead: A papercraft pop-up diorama: a tiny world built from layered cut paper and folded cardstock, with crisp paper edges, subtle paper grain and soft shadows between layers, standing on a round paper base. In the diorama:
paper.look: Handmade, delicate and precise, like a pop-up book page come to life.
paper.guard: The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Show only what is described: no extra people or animals. Plain seamless off-white background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
